snippet.title: Rune Factory 3 Part 15
snippet.description:
[Read Description]
WATCH IN HD!

So now I'm getting really close to getting the last item and fight the boss of the second dungeon.

I purchase some new spells that will really help with the request the Univir leader has us do.

But first I do a couple requests in town. The first one I do is by Sofia and when I first got here, I had NO idea what I was doing.

And just so you know, this is the last video I had prepared ahead of time so don't expect any new videos of anything for at least a week or two.

Rate, subscribe, comment and share. Thank you and enjoy.
